Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Evaluated with two open-source frameworks: Microsoft's Eureka ML Insights (internal development benchmarks/ablations; MathVista, MMMU-CoT, ScreenSpot/ScreenSpot-V2, ScreenSpot-Pro, V*Bench) and VLMEvalKit (standardized community benchmarks, e.g. AI2D TEST split, ChartQA TEST split, MathVista MINI split). WildVision used GPT-4o as judge. Shots, prompts and other settings are not stated; evaluation logs will be released publicly.
quotes: Two evaluation frameworks were used: Microsoft's Eureka ML Insights for internal development benchmarks, and VLMEvalKit for standardized community benchmarks. Evaluation logs will be released publicly.
Used during development for internal benchmarks and ablation studies. The following benchmarks were evaluated through this framework:
Used for standardized community benchmark evaluation. The following benchmarks were evaluated through this framework:

**AI2D (TEST split):** Diagram understanding over ~5K illustrative diagrams from grade school natural sciences, evaluating the ability to interpret diagrammatic elements, relationships, and structure.
**WildVision:** Real-world human preference evaluation benchmark with 500 high-quality samples curated from 8,000 user submissions, using GPT-4o as judge.
